profile.headline: Lead Frontend Engineer | Angular • TypeScript • RxJS | Data-Driven Enterprise Platforms | 9+ Years Shipping Client-Facing Web Apps
profile.summary:
Lead frontend engineer with 9+ years building externally-facing, client-facing web applications in Angular. Proven frontend tech lead — architecting scalable, component-based UIs, mentoring engineers, and partnering with Product, Design, QA, and executive stakeholders to ship business-critical data-driven platforms.

Specialties
• Angular (v2 through v17) • TypeScript • RxJS • SCSS • Component-Based Architecture
• RESTful APIs • Data Visualization (Highcharts, D3.js) • Responsive Design
• Frontend Architecture • Code Quality Standards • Release Management
• Team Mentoring • Cross-Functional Collaboration • Agile / Scrum

Track record of modernizing legacy applications (jQuery / AngularJS → modern Angular), raising team code quality standards, and driving release activities in production. Experienced embedding AI-powered features (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, vector search) into real user workflows.

Currently leading frontend for a market-intelligence platform used by enterprise clients. Always interested in hard frontend problems where architecture, user experience, and data visualization intersect.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer (Frontend) / Tech Lead
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Lead frontend delivery of client-facing and internal Angular applications — setting technical direction, raising code quality standards, and aligning contributors around shared architecture and component patterns.

Architect scalable, component-based Angular (v2 through v17) interfaces in TypeScript, integrating RESTful APIs for real-time data visualization (Highcharts, D3.js) across a market-intelligence platform used by enterprise clients.

Mentor engineers and interns across the team through code reviews, pairing, and technical guidance — raising consistency, throughput, and execution quality.

Own frontend release activities — coordinating deployments, monitoring production, and troubleshooting defects and performance issues end-to-end.

Partner with Product, Design, QA, and executive stakeholders to translate ambiguous requirements into incremental, shippable solutions embedded in real user workflows.

Drive AI-powered product features (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, vector search) and internal Microsoft Teams applications, coordinating requirements, rollout, and adoption with business stakeholders.

Support Agile execution through backlog refinement, estimation, sprint planning, retrospectives, and post-release follow-ups.

positions.title: Software Engineer | Client and Internal Application Developer
positions.description:
Migrated client-facing dashboard from jQuery / AngularJS to Angular 2+, modernizing the component architecture and improving maintainability.

Built interactive Angular dashboards and responsive UI features (login, registration, accessibility, filtering) in TypeScript, integrating RESTful APIs for live market data.

Established testing protocols that reduced production bugs by 40% and improved overall product reliability.

Partnered with product and design stakeholders to gather requirements and incorporate user feedback into iterative releases.

Maintained and modernized existing systems for adaptation to business and technology changes.

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
Led a small team during a 36-hour hackathon to design and build a web application connecting veterans with employment opportunities.

Coordinated scope, task breakdown, and delivery while contributing full-stack development.

Presented the final solution to judges and stakeholders.
positions.insights: Skills: AngularJS · ASP.NET MVC · Full-Stack Development · Agile Methodologies · RESTful WebServices

positions.title: Hackathon Project Lead & Full-Stack Developer
positions.description:
Facebook-Sponsored Hackathon 

Led a small team during a 36-hour hackathon to design and build VetConnect, a web application connecting military veterans with employers seeking their skills and experience.

Owned project scope, task breakdown, and end-to-end delivery while contributing full-stack development.

Delivered a working prototype that streamlined the transition from military service to civilian employment.

Built using JavaScript, C#, T-SQL, Google Maps API, and SendGrid API.

positions.title: Registered Respiratory Therapist
positions.description:
Delivered respiratory care in fast-paced clinical environments, collaborating with multidisciplinary medical teams.

Made critical decisions under pressure while balancing patient care, safety, and time-sensitive priorities.

positions.title: Registered Respiratory Therapist
positions.description:
Delivered respiratory care and ventilatory support for patients in fast-paced clinical environments.

Collaborated closely with physicians, nurses, and care teams to execute treatment plans accurately and efficiently.

Made time-sensitive decisions under pressure while balancing patient safety, care quality, and operational priorities.

positions.title: Respiratory Equipment Technician
positions.description:
Prepared, maintained, and troubleshot respiratory equipment used across ICU, emergency, pediatric, and neonatal units.

Ensured equipment readiness through decontamination, system checks, and preventative maintenance prior to patient use.

Oriented and supported new respiratory therapists and technicians on equipment setup and operational procedures.

Coordinated inventory ordering and stocking to ensure uninterrupted availability of critical equipment and supplies.

positions.title: Operations Manager
positions.description:
Managed daily operations and led a team of six employees in a high-traffic retail environment.

Set schedules, defined performance expectations, and trained staff to meet customer service and sales goals.

Coached team members through feedback and on-the-job training, improving consistency and execution.

Owned inventory management, purchasing, and day-to-day operational execution under time and resource constraints.

positions.title: IT Technical Support
positions.description:
Provided technical support for POS systems, resolving transactional and account issues for technicians and customers.

Acted as a first point of contact for issue triage, prioritizing and resolving problems to maintain operational continuity.

Maintained system and membership data accuracy through timely updates and validation.

honors.title: Outstanding Clinical Performance Award
honors.issuer: Issued by El Camino College Respiratory Care Program · May 2015

honors.title: CeEtta Crayton Community Development Award
honors.description: Professor CeEtta Crayton founded the Therapeutic Recreation Program at CSULB and was a founding member of the Ethnic Minority Section of CPRS.  This scholarship honors her memory by recognizing undergraduate students who demonstrate professional and career promise by volunteering or working in the recreation field to foster individual and/or community development with underserved populations while maintaining a strong academic record.
honors.issuer: Issued by California State University of Long Beach · Jun 2009

projects.title: Veteran Connect (VetConnect)
projects.description: Vet Connect, Our mission is to "Serve Those Who Served" by connecting veterans of America's armed forces with employers who value their experience and skills. In our experience, when transitioning from military service to civilian life, we've found that there is no good avenue to communicate directly with companies or with our peers. VetConnect has been created for you. We continue to evolve to provide you the best career transition services available on the web. Please remember, VetConnect is a tool to help you in your job search.
